newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain has still scope to cut official rate - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain has still scope to cut official rate - Montoro.

text.p: Spain's Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said the decline in interest rates has not yet reached a floor.
"The reduction of interest rates will continue this year, and maybe also next year," Montoro said in a radio interview.
"We have not reached the floor, there's still scope for further reductions".
The Bank of Spain had cut its key money market rate three times this year, pushing it down by a total of 75 basis points to 5.50 percent.
Montoro said that with Spain's entry in the European monetary union the country will never have such high interest levels as it had in the past.
"Interest rates can change, but they will never be back where they were before," Montoro said.
He also said that in its 1996, 1997 and 1998 accounts Spain will have saved more than 700 billion pesetas thanks to lower interest rates.
